verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a reconciliation webhook event (`bvnk:ledger:report:ready`) for receiving transaction reports, which supports accounting consumption, and mentions partner markup fees, but there is no documented timing from payment to available balance nor a published fee schedule per settlement rail. missing for 10: settlement timing documentation (payment-to-available-balance SLAs), published per-rail fee schedules, and detailed statement/report format specs for accounting.
